daily.brief: 過去約25.5小時（17日19:30到18日21:03）有306則帖、104個帳號。最明顯的共識是零售改善，$TGT有5個帳號看好、零看淡，Q3大幅超預期並上調指引，可比銷售額+5.6%。記憶體和neocloud也因Nvidia強勁財報獲支持，MU有4個、NBIS有4個。黃金GLD被點名處於熊市。
daily.full:
共識

TGT這輪最乾淨，5個帳號看好、沒有看淡，6則帖。@Retail_Guru認為HD和LOW剛剛實現四年來最佳comps，很難辯稱不是消費潮上升，TGT流量+5%自2022年1月以來最佳。原帖。@Stephanie_Link說它重新成為目的地，出色的超預期/上調，可比銷售額+5.6%，可能是第三季超越WMT。原帖。@DeItaone報告Q3調整後EPS $2.65對估計$2.07（超28%），收入$27.07B，上調FY26指引。原帖。

MU有4個帳號看好。@The_AI_Investor看多記憶體，因NVIDIA供應承諾爆炸，Q3 FY2026 503億、Q4 952億、Q1 FY2027 1190億。原帖。@aleabitoreddit指NVDA需求遠超供應，對MU有利，供應承諾從2790億增至3900億美元，收入增長約75%同比。原帖。NBIS有4個，@Sandeman52說Jensen後的恐懼已解除。原帖。@daniel_koss認為NVDA現在將開始挑選贏家，顯然NBIS和CRWV會想到。原帖。

LOW也有3個帳號看好，@LiveSquawk報告可比銷售額+1.8%（預期+0.37%），調整後EPS 3.10美元（預期2.92美元）。原帖。

共同看淡

GLD有2個帳號看淡。@alphatrends指出黃金繼續處於熊市，創下年內新低。原帖。

分歧

NVDA是絕對主角，188則帖，split裡22個看好對10個看淡。@ACInvestorBlog說NVIDIA剛交出另一個強勁季度，報告1158億美元收入（同比增長103%），並上調展望，明確指出來自neoclouds和前沿實驗室對AI基礎設施的「非凡需求」。原帖。@garyblack00報告盤前反彈，因Nvidia強勁Q4及2027指引確認穩健AI需求，NVDA盤前漲3.1%至$160。原帖。@InvestmentGuru_提到單季回購220億美元股票，並支付60億美元股息。原帖。但@RagingVentures擔心最終GPU/ASIC-TPU供應商過多，需求不可持續，全部都是做空對象包括AMD AVGO。原帖。

AAOI有分歧，@BlackPantherCap認為他們報告的是供應短缺而非需求短缺，即使擴產後預計滿足不到80%需求。原帖。但@JonahLupton說應以目前市值被收購，管理團隊另尋工作，以這些價格進行ATM應屬犯罪，稀釋股東。原帖。@StockSavvyShay直指管理層是個笑話。原帖。

其他值得留意

整體來看，Nvidia財報確認AI需求穩健帶動盤前反彈，零售名字因comps改善獲共識，黃金則被視為熊市。306則帖來自104個帳號，討論集中在AI鏈和消費。

今日重點

TGT獲5個帳號共識看好，Q3可比銷售額+5.6%並上調指引，零售改善敘事清晰。Nvidia財報確認AI需求穩健，盤前漲至$160附近，MU和NBIS等受益名字獲支持。黃金GLD被點名繼續熊市、創年內新低。

daily.brief: Over the past ~25.5 hours (19:30 on the 17th to 21:03 on the 18th) there were 306 posts from 104 accounts. The clearest consensus is retail improvement: $TGT has 5 accounts bullish with zero bearish after a big Q3 beat and raised guidance, comps +5.6%. Memory and neoclouds also gained support from Nvidia’s strong results, with MU at 4 and NBIS at 4. Gold GLD was flagged as still in a bear market.
daily.full:
Consensus

TGT was the cleanest this round, 5 bullish accounts and no bearish, 6 posts. @Retail_Guru argued HD and LOW just delivered their best comps in four years, hard to claim it’s not a rising consumption tide, TGT traffic +5% best since Jan 2022. original post. @Stephanie_Link said it is becoming a destination again, strong beat/raise, comps +5.6%, possibly outperforming WMT in Q3. original post. @DeItaone reported Q3 adjusted EPS $2.65 vs $2.07 est (28% beat), revenue $27.07B, raised FY26 guidance. original post.

MU has 4 bullish accounts. @The_AI_Investor is long memory because NVIDIA supply commitments are exploding: Q3 FY2026 $50.3B, Q4 $95.2B, Q1 FY2027 $119B. original post. @aleabitoreddit noted NVDA demand far exceeds supply, beneficial for MU, supply commitments from $279B to $390B, revenue growth ~75% YoY. original post. NBIS has 4; @Sandeman52 said the fear after Jensen is off the neck. original post. @daniel_koss thinks NVDA will now start picking winners, clearly NBIS and CRWV come to mind. original post.

LOW also has 3 bullish accounts; @LiveSquawk reported comps +1.8% (vs +0.37% est), adj EPS $3.10 (vs $2.92). original post.

Joint Bearish

GLD has 2 bearish accounts. @alphatrends noted gold continues in a bear market, making a new yearly low. original post.

Divergence

NVDA is the absolute protagonist with 188 posts; in the split 22 bullish vs 10 bearish. @ACInvestorBlog said NVIDIA just delivered another strong quarter, reporting $115.8B revenue (+103% YoY) and raising outlook, explicitly citing “extraordinary demand” from neoclouds and frontier labs for AI infrastructure. original post. @garyblack00 reported pre-market bounce on Nvidia’s strong Q4 and 2027 guidance confirming robust AI demand, NVDA up 3.1% to $160. original post. @InvestmentGuru_ noted a single-quarter buyback of $22B in stock plus $6B dividend. original post. But @RagingVentures worries that ultimately there are too many GPU/ASIC-TPU suppliers, demand is unsustainable, and all are shorts including AMD AVGO. original post.

AAOI is split. @BlackPantherCap said they are reporting supply shortage not demand shortage, and even after expansion expect to meet less than 80% of demand. original post. But @JonahLupton said it should be acquired at current market cap, management should find other jobs, doing ATM at these prices should be a crime for diluting shareholders. original post. @StockSavvyShay called management a joke. original post.

Other Noteworthy

Overall, Nvidia’s results confirmed robust AI demand driving the pre-market bounce, retail names gained consensus from improving comps, while gold is viewed as in a bear market. 306 posts from 104 accounts, discussion concentrated on the AI chain and consumption.

briefing.html:
Today's Highlights

TGT has consensus from 5 accounts after Q3 comps +5.6% and raised guidance, retail improvement narrative clear. Nvidia results confirmed robust AI demand, pre-market up near $160, with MU and NBIS benefiting. Gold GLD flagged as continuing in a bear market with a new yearly low.

Weekly AMAT consensus remains strong; monthly SOFI and AMAT also supported, but the large name NVDA continues to show divergence.
